name: HistoricalAlerts
description: Sortable data table of historical alerts within a controlled date range. Renders a header with title + `DateRangePicker`, then the table

props.name: alerts
props.description: Pre-fetched historical alerts log entries (each with a `thing` device payload)

props.name: localFilters
props.description: Filters and search tags coming from the parent (typically shared with `CurrentAlerts`)

props.name: dateRange
props.description: Selected date range for the historical query (controlled)

props.name: onAlertClick
props.type: ((id?: string | undefined, uuid?: string | undefined) => void)
props.description: Called when the user opens an alert

fields.name: start
fields.description: Range start, epoch ms; seeds the picker's `from` date

fields.name: end
fields.description: Range end, epoch ms; seeds the picker's `to` date
